podcast.body: Released on September 11, 2001, this album focused on themes of living and striving rather than death and dying. Its positive message resonated with many people seeking hope after the 9/11 attacks, potentially contributing to its popularity. A significant number of listeners were drawn to the album without knowing the band's Christian background, simply appreciating P.O.D. as a great rock band. "Alive from POD and their 2001 Breakthrough album, Satellite. A record all about living and striving instead of death and dying and the awful things that come with life."
